purpose: Test whether verified dealer-inventory sign, liquidity-normalized hedge impact, and cost-aware delta hedging add prospective information beyond price/realized-volatility baselines.

markets.us: listed equity/ETF/index options with exact contract and participant/open-close or audited inventory provenance
markets.commodity: options on an exact futures contract with contract-specific underlying and venue
markets.fx: listed options or a valid exact vol-surface product; FX spot alone is forbidden
markets.crypto: venue-listed options, exact underlying and venue; no cross-venue dealer aggregation
markets.ihsg: disabled until a liquid listed-options product and admissible data contract exist

primary_claims.claim: Verified long-gamma inventory is associated with more post-shock reversion and verified short-gamma inventory with more post-shock amplification than the frozen price/liquidity baseline.
primary_claims.outcome: signed 30m and 120m return continuation after a frozen 15m standardized spot shock
primary_claims.baseline: shock size, trailing realized volatility, spread, depth, time-of-day, event-day flag; no option inventory sign
primary_claims.loss: clustered out-of-sample log loss for continuation classification plus Brier calibration

primary_claims.claim: Verified liquidity-normalized hedge notional improves pin-versus-break and first-passage calibration around registered option concentration zones.
primary_claims.outcome: zone pin, accepted break, and first passage by 30m/120m/close
primary_claims.baseline: distance-to-zone, realized volatility, volume, spread, depth, DTE and time-of-day without signed hedge notional
primary_claims.loss: integrated Brier score and interval calibration

primary_claims.claim: A frozen delta-hedged long-option policy has positive net P&L relative to its option premium/theta and explicit execution-cost baseline when forecast realized variance exceeds implied variance.
primary_claims.outcome: realized delta-hedged P&L net of option spread, hedge spread, slippage, commissions, funding and discrete-hedge error
primary_claims.baseline: no-trade and same-option buy-and-hold; headline IV-minus-RV alone is not a pass
primary_claims.loss: net P&L, expected shortfall, calibration and turnover-adjusted utility

frozen_design.split: chronological monthly folds; first 60% development, next 20% untouched validation, final 20% prospective lockbox; no row-random split
frozen_design.purge_embargo: at least maximum outcome horizon between folds
frozen_design.multiplicity: Holm correction across exactly three primary claims; secondary diagnostics cannot rescue a failed primary claim
frozen_design.costs: actual quoted option and hedge spreads when available; otherwise conservative registered schedule fixed before observation
frozen_design.clustering: date and underlying clustered inference; no contract rows treated as independent when they share an underlying/date
frozen_design.promotion: validation and prospective lockbox both improve the frozen baseline; adjusted lower confidence bound must be positive; calibration and false-alarm gates pass; at least two admissible market families for any cross-market claim
frozen_design.retuning: forbidden after the first signed observation; protocol changes require a new version and a new untouched window

required_row_lineage: exact option contract, underlying, expiry, strike, option type, multiplier and venue
bid, ask, quote timestamp, IV and Greeks or reproducible model inputs
open-interest timestamp and open/close/participant classification or audited inventory receipt
dealer_inventory_verified, dealer_sign, confidence, source and observation timestamp
underlying trade/quote/depth timestamps, spread, volume and depth
fees, commissions, funding and execution policy
source payload SHA-256 and schema version
forbidden_shortcuts: calls positive and puts negative creates dealer GEX
provider gamma flip is accepted without methodology and inventory provenance
call wall or put wall is a guaranteed target/support/resistance
IV greater or less than trailing RV proves gamma-scalping profit
post-outcome threshold, horizon, market, strike or expiry shopping
